careCircle.sectionSubtitle: Privacy-first collaboration between patients, doctors, and nurses
careCircle.heroTitle: Connected Care, Directed by the Patient
careCircle.heroSubtitle: A real-time coordination loop connecting patients, doctors, and nurses with clear accountability.

patient.title: Patient
patient.summary: Retains master ownership of all records and authorizes clinical access.
bullets: Authorizes or revokes granular access by category
Sets strict expiration windows for consultations
Reviews real-time audit ledger of all record views

doctor.title: Doctor
doctor.summary: Requests specific category access and enters verified diagnoses.
bullets: Submits consent requests with explicit clinical purpose
Reviews longitudinal history and diagnostic labs
Delegates medication orders and vital checks to nurses

nurse.title: Nurse
nurse.summary: Coordinates bedside care, documents vitals, and executes orders.
bullets: Accepts and executes prioritized bedside care tasks
Documents medication administrations in real time
Maintains continuous vitals flowsheet with instant alerts

permissions.name: Permissions Flow
permissions.question: Who can see my information?
permissions.summary: Patient-directed consent rules dictate who can view sensitive health information with time-limited authorization and instant revocation.
permissions.patientRole: Grants or revokes granular access across clinical categories.
permissions.doctorRole: Receives time-bound permission for approved categories only.
permissions.nurseRole: Accesses records strictly required for assigned bedside tasks.

records.name: Medical Records Flow
records.question: What information is shared?
records.summary: Diagnoses, lab test results, medication history, and vitals flow seamlessly between verified care team members without data silos.
records.patientRole: Retains master ownership of all clinical history and notes.
records.doctorRole: Reviews longitudinal chart and enters clinical diagnoses.
records.nurseRole: Views authorized observations and current prescription orders.

tasks.name: Care Tasks Flow
tasks.question: What care actions are planned?
tasks.summary: Attending physicians assign specific care tasks to available nurses, ensuring clear responsibility for patient care.
tasks.patientRole: Sees active care plan and scheduled medication timings.
tasks.doctorRole: Delegates medication doses, vital checks, and lab sample collection.
tasks.nurseRole: Accepts tasks, documents dose administration, and records vitals.

updates.name: Real-time Updates Flow
updates.question: What is happening right now?
updates.summary: Every access event, clinical measurement, and medication status change is logged into an immutable ledger and streamed in real time.
updates.patientRole: Receives instant alerts when records are accessed or shared.
updates.doctorRole: Gets notified of abnormal vitals or completed nurse tasks.
updates.nurseRole: Receives immediate notification of newly assigned physician orders.
